title: Lebesgue's universal covering problem on the minimum-area convex shape in the plane that can cover any shape of diameter one
exact_target: What is the smallest area of a convex planar set that can contain, after a rigid motion, every planar set of diameter one?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 7200072 (AMR-071-0072). CC BY 4.0.
Philip Gibbs, A New Slant on Lebesgue’s Universal Covering Problem (2014); arXiv:1401.8217.
